wikipedia.title: Dhupadal
wikipedia.text:
Dhupadal  is a village in the southern state of Karnataka, India. It is located in the Gokak taluk of Belagavi district in Karnataka.


== Demographics ==
As of 2001 India census, Dhupadal had a population of 9658 with 4784 males and 4874 females.

wikipedia.title: Gokak Falls
wikipedia.text: The Gokak Falls is a waterfall located on the Ghataprabha River in Belagavi district of Karnataka, India. The waterfall is 6.5 kilometers away from Gokak town.

wikipedia.title: Gokak Falls, Belgaum
wikipedia.text: Gokak Falls  is a town in Belagavi district in the Indian state of Karnataka. It is under the control of municipal corporation Konnur, Karnataka.
